title: Meta AI wearable device Muse Charm reportedly priced at $300

content_html:
According to The Information, Meta plans to price its upcoming electronic pet egg–style AI wearable, Muse Charm, at $300. The product was previously unveiled at a Connect event earlier in 2026. As of November 19, 2026, a Meta spokesperson did not deny the pricing rumor, only responding that the company is pleased by the public attention and will disclose more information soon.

As an important move by Meta to expand consumer AI hardware, Muse Charm continues the product lineage of the company's smart assistant Muse and personalized virtual avatar system. It lets users carry their software avatar in a pocket or wear it around the neck for real-time conversations, questions, and command interactions. The AI wearable sector is still in an early stage of exploration and form-factor validation. Products such as the Humane AI badge previously fell short of market expectations, but manufacturers continue to iterate.

In terms of pricing, $300 is relatively high for a keychain-sized device, but it is in a similar range to AI startup Friend's comparable conversational wearable, which sells for $250. By contrast, Amazon's newly launched Bee Frontier AI wearable, which supports conversation transcription and task tracking, is priced at $75, with a 30% Black Friday discount price of $52.49. Even adding an annual $99 app connection subscription fee, the overall cost remains lower than Muse Charm.

This pricing strategy reflects the divergence in AI wearable hardware between two paths: "emotional companionship and character interaction" and "cost-effective practical tools." Its eventual market acceptance still needs to be validated through real-world experience and commercial conversion after the product launches.
